source_findings.finding: Early return compares only the table element, caret key and selected keys; individual cell element identity is absent.

Even without the early return, caret lookup is gated on table/caret-key changes, and selection delta loops skip keys retained in the set. The cached-element connectivity fallback cannot help unless lookup executes.
Unmount cleanup restores only the previously tracked caret element's inline color. It does not remove selected attributes.

plite_commit_claim.assessment: The claim classifies host mutations for integrity ownership; it has no table-paint reapplication or selected-attribute disposal contract. useTableSelectionDOM does not subscribe to the root layout notifications, and its own render still returns early. Existing Plite mutation-observer lifecycle tests cover ownership/hostile mutation repair, not this cell lifetime.
